data.summary: Marketplace release = edit one file: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json source.sha (40-char) is the version pin; no version field, no git tag
data.detail: Pinning a new plugin version in colton-claude-plugins means swapping that plugin's source.sha in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to the plugin repo's released HEAD. Runbook: (a) git ls-remote the real HEAD — never trust a relayed short SHA; (b) confirm version at that ref via gh api on plugin.json + pyproject.toml (must agree, and must be the NEW version as proof of bump); (c) swap source.sha; (d) commit+push origin main; (e) verify local HEAD == remote; (f) close loop with requester. Standing rule: only pin+push when Colton explicitly says go. Plugin maintainer cuts the version (3 files must agree: src/__init__.py, plugin.json, pyproject.toml + uv.lock + green tests); marketplace owner (now Loki) does the pin.
context: teammate-comms and vibe-cognition plugin releases. Handed from Silvie to Loki. Repos: Haagndaazer/colton-claude-plugins (marketplace)
